# Technical Architecture & Full Specification: QR

> Complete reference manual for Autonomous AI Coding Agents & LLMs.
> Host: https://injest.in/qr/
> License: MIT License (Open Source)
> Repository: https://github.com/injest-in/qr

## 1. Architectural Principles
- **100% Client-Side Execution:** The application has no server-side backend, database, tracking pixels, telemetry beacons, or external APIs. All QR matrix computation, vCard string formatting, iCalendar serialization, and PDF rendering execute in browser memory.
- **Offline PWA:** Operates seamlessly without an active internet connection via Service Worker caching (/qr/sw.js).
- **Deterministic Two-Way Hash Binding:** Every input field has a 250ms debounced binding to window.location.hash.

## 2. Hash Route & Query Parameter Matrix

| Route | Mode / Purpose | Allowed Query Parameters | Generated Protocol |
|---|---|---|---|
| #/whatsapp | WhatsApp Direct Chat | cc, phone, msg | https://wa.me/<cc><phone>?text=<msg> |
| #/email | Mailto Draft | 	o, sub, ody | mailto:<to>?subject=<sub>&body=<body> |
| #/phone | Telephone Dialer | cc, 
um | 	el:<cc><num> |
| #/link | Website URL | url | https://... |
| #/upi | UPI Payment Intent | pa, pn, m, 	n | upi://pay?pa=<pa>&pn=<pn>&am=<am>&tn=<tn> |
| #/wifi | Wi-Fi Credentials | ssid, p, 	, h | WIFI:S:<ssid>;T:<t>;P:<p>;H:<h>;; |
| #/vcard | Business Card Contact | n, ln, 	el, em, org, 	itle, url, dr | RFC 2426 vCard 3.0 |
| #/maps | Turn-by-Turn Navigation | lat, lng, 
ame, mode | https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1... |
| #/calendar | iCalendar Event | 	itle, start, end, loc, desc | RFC 5545 iCalendar (BEGIN:VCALENDAR...) |
| #/pay-gate | Merchant Dual-Action Setup | pa, pn, m, 	n, wa | https://injest.in/qr/#/pay?... |
| #/pay | Customer Settlement Gate | pa, pn, m, 	n, wa | Renders dual UPI Pay + WhatsApp proof actions |
| #/servicenow | ServiceNow Incident/Request | instance, 	able, mode, sys_id | Native ServiceNow navigation URLs |
| #/form | Google / Survey Form Prefill | url | Form prefill URL |
| #/uber | Uber Ride Dispatch | lat, lng, 
ick | https://m.uber.com/ul/?action=setPickup... |
| #/catalog | WhatsApp Business Catalog | cc, phone | https://wa.me/c/<cc><phone> |
| #/batch | Batch CSV Studio | (none) | Opens bulk generation modal |
| #/scan | Camera / File Scanner | (none) | Opens standard QR scanner |
| #/staff | Staff Mode Inspector | (none) | Opens reverse-ingestion inspector |

## 3. Reverse-Ingestion Schema Parser
When decoding raw QR payloads:
- Starts with WIFI: -> Decoded into SSID, Password, Encryption, Hidden flag.
- Starts with upi://pay -> Decoded into Payee VPA, Payee Name, Amount, Note.
- Starts with BEGIN:VCARD -> Decoded into FN, Telephone, Email, Org, Title.
- Starts with mailto: -> Decoded into Recipient, Subject, Body.
- Starts with 	el: -> Decoded into E.164 phone number.
- Contains service-now.com -> Decoded into Platform or Service Portal parameters.
- Valid JSON { or [ -> Recursively flattened into dot-delimited key/value table.
